data.gender_notes: Nicky is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Nikos, meaning 'victory'. In Christianity, this name is associated with St. Nicholas, a bishop renowned for his generosity and miracles. Nicky can symbolize the victory of good over evil. The name Nicky carries the meaning “Victory of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nicky usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: Derived from the Greek name Nikos, meaning 'victory'. This name holds significant cultural weight within Greek and Christian traditions. data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Nicky is closely connected to Saint Nicholas, a bishop and patron saint known for his generosity, kindness, and miracles. As such, the name can hold deep spiritual significance for Christians. The victory represented in the name Nicky can symbolize the triumph of good over evil, the victory of faith over doubt, and the victory of selflessness and compassion over selfishness and indifference. Nicky can serve as a reminder of the virtues that Christ embodied and that we, as Christians, should strive to emulate in our own lives.
